observations: A keyboard with black and white keys lies diagonally across both photos, still wrapped in clear plastic film in several places (keys partly exposed, body still covered).
The word 'YAMAHA' is printed in white near the bottom-left of the instrument's control panel in both photo 0 and photo 1.
A row of small buttons, an LED numeric display, and two round control knobs/pads are visible on the control panel.
A printed strip of demo-song/rhythm names runs along the top of the panel, but the text is too small and angled to read clearly.
A specific model number or series code is not legible in either photo due to angle, glare, and plastic wrap reflection.
In the background, two boxed items (possibly a stereo/speaker system box marked with partial text 'U-3211D' or similar) and a person's arm/hand are visible, suggesting a shop display setting.

claims.evidence: No audio or video provided; sound quality cannot be assessed from static photos.
YAMAHA logo visible on the panel in photo 0 and photo 1.

risks.risk: Exact Yamaha model unknown, which drives price heavily (entry-level vs mid-range keyboards vary greatly).
risks.proof: A clear, close-up, well-lit photo of the model name/number printed on the control panel or rear label.
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced even at worst case without model identification

risks.risk: Keyboard may not power on or keys/buttons may be faulty (plastic wrap suggests it may be new-in-box, but no power-on test shown).
risks.proof: A short video clip showing the keyboard powered on, keys pressed, and sound audible.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power adapter, stand, sustain pedal) that affect usability and value.
risks.proof: Photo of included accessories laid out together with the keyboard.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unit only, no accessories

risks.risk: Cosmetic damage hidden under the plastic wrap (scratches, cracked keys).
risks.proof: Photos with the plastic wrap fully removed, showing the entire body and keys unobstructed.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming visible wear, worst case for cosmetic condition

Video of the keyboard powered on with keys played and sound audible.
Photo of any included accessories (adapter, stand, pedal).
Full-body photo with plastic wrap removed.
response.reason: The brand Yamaha is readable, but the specific model number that determines price is not legible in either photo, and no power-on or accessory evidence is shown.
